posts.title: Handling high-stakes escalations when every option is bad
posts.description: Engineering blogs love to pretend that executive escalations are just a communication problem: summarize the bug in a clean one-pager, present three balanced options, and everyone in the room will find an agreement and pick a sensible option.

posts.title: Moving dozens of teams without a mandate
posts.description: Most cross-org initiatives die because the author writes a design doc, files tickets in other teams' backlogs, and complains to leadership when nobody prioritizes them.

posts.title: Kubernetes doesn't care about your uptime
posts.description: It's 3:00 AM. A node in your production cluster has gone dark. You wait for the Kubernetes scheduler to do its magic: to recognize the loss and spin up your database elsewhere. But nothing happens. Why?
